description: Test cases for multi-format attachment ingestion.

evals.name: csv-ingestion
evals.prompt: Ingest sample.csv and produce priming-rag doc with schema and head.
evals.expected_output: priming-rag-sample.md with frontmatter, schema, head 20 rows, [ADJUNTO:sample.csv:col=X] tags
assertions: redaction applied if any secret-like cells

evals.name: xlsx-multi-sheet
evals.expected_output: priming doc with per-sheet blocks, named ranges listed, [ADJUNTO:report.xlsx:sheet=NAME]

evals.name: pdf-multi-page
evals.expected_output: priming doc with text per page + table section, [ADJUNTO:whitepaper.pdf:page=N]
assertions: pdfplumber tables section present if tables exist

evals.name: docx-headings-tables
evals.prompt: Ingest spec.docx with headings and 2 tables.
evals.expected_output: priming doc preserving heading hierarchy + table contents

evals.name: pptx-slides-notes
evals.prompt: Ingest kickoff.pptx (20 slides with speaker notes).
evals.expected_output: priming doc with per-slide block + notes section

evals.name: html-page
evals.prompt: Ingest landing.html with tables and links.
evals.expected_output: priming doc with clean text + tables + links sections

evals.name: code-python
evals.expected_output: priming doc with imports + signatures + head

evals.name: unknown-fallback
evals.expected_output: priming doc via extract-generic.sh with file-type + strings + hexdump
